author: EmuCore - Hub
title: PS2 on Android Testing (AetherSX2) - This is WILD! 😱 US vs PAL roms difference! Part 1 of 2
summary: Humble Hardware tests an early AetherSX2 build across nineteen named games while pausing to compare US and PAL software behavior, showing how region frame targets can alter the apparent performance of one Android device.

blocks.text: The video first records the application and settings, then moves rapidly through titles including Baldur’s Gate, Burnout 3, Final Fantasy XII, Klonoa 2 and both early God of War games. Two separate region discussions are embedded beside games rather than treated as trivia. PAL releases often target different video rates from NTSC counterparts, so a device may appear to gain headroom without the emulator or hardware becoming faster. A public testing spreadsheet extends the evidence beyond the edited showcase.

This February 2022 material represents AetherSX2 near its early public period and cannot describe later forks or modern Android drivers. Region choice can also change game speed, language, timing and code revision; “PAL” is not a free optimization preset. Short clips do not establish completion or input latency. Use personal lawful dumps, identify the serial and intended refresh behavior, then compare equivalent scenes with the same settings and thermal state. Consult the linked spreadsheet as dated observations rather than a permanent compatibility database.
